correctness.rationale: PASS. For n>=2 the cube homomorphism on the cyclic unit group (Z/3^n)^* has kernel size three and image exactly ±1 mod9. Nonunit cubes vanish mod27. The residue classes ±1, ±2, 3/4/5/6 and 0 mod9 therefore partition all targets with the stated counts. For r=0 mod9, fix unit x and set y=-x+3t; x^3+y^3=9 t(x^2-3xt+3t^2), whose derivative is x^2 mod3 and whose reduction is x^2 t, proving Hensel bijection for each n and exactly 2*3^n opposite-unit pairs. For both coordinates multiples of three, each lower modulus 3^(n-3) pair has 3^4=81 lifts. n=0,1,2 treated separately. Independent exact cyclic cube-frequency convolution checked every target for n=1..7 (3+9+27+81+243+729+2187=3279 residues), reproducing N_n(1)=2*3^n. This finite corroboration is not the universal proof.
